findings.body: When a job has no persisted run ID, the production spawn tracker generates a telemetry-only `credential-run:` ID (`infrastructure/observability/spawn-turn-tracker.ts:57`). The inline lane forwards that ID as `correlationRunId` (`runtime/agent-inline.ts:466`), and this line then stores it in `parent_run_id`, violating the foreign key to `agent_runs` instead of saving the job link alone. IPC delegation has the same gap: `ipc-agent-task-lifecycle-handlers.ts:521` forwards the sandbox correlation ID to `ipc-delegated-agent-execution.ts:54`. Both paths must distinguish a persisted agent-run ID from a synthetic correlation ID and leave the run link null for the latter. The nullable-edge integration case exercises only commands, and the harness sets correlation IDs directly from input run IDs, so it misses this failure in both delegation lanes.
findings.title: Not done: job-started subagents without a run save with the job link only
